title: Palghar police arrest seven over fake call centre targeting US citizens
date_note: The420.in says the Crime Branch raid was on Tuesday 24 November; the page was published 25 November.
place: Bhopoli village, Vikramgad taluka, Palghar, Maharashtra
summary: The420.in reports that a Palghar Crime Branch team raided a bungalow in Bhopoli village on 24 November and seven men were arrested under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and the Information Technology Act. Police allege the suspects messaged US citizens that their devices had viruses and had them buy gift cards and share the codes. Superintendent of Police Yatish Deshmukh confirmed the arrests; the number of victims is not yet established.
plain: Palghar police arrested seven men at a fake call centre. Police allege they told US residents their devices had viruses and got them to share gift card codes.
exec: Indian police say they arrested seven people at a call centre allegedly defrauding US citizens with fake virus warnings.
